assessment_note: Same five weights as VS30. Co-op planning credit rises 50 to 65 for integrated verified local session lifecycle, adding three weighted points. No finished art, human-fun, Internet or minimum-PC credit. Range is a subjective judgment band, not a statistical confidence interval.
